title: Remove the fixed height:32 on OfflineTopBanner's Container so large text-scale doesn't clip it
rule: AX-4 (no fixed heights on text wrappers)
why: The banner's Container is given a tight height:32 which forces the same tight cross-axis height onto the Row wrapping the cloud-off Icon and the offline-message Text. The app sets no textScaler clamp anywhere (grep-confirmed repo-wide), so under a standard OS large-text accessibility setting the Text needs more than 32 logical pixels; because Container does not clip by default, the text would paint outside the 32px band, visually overlapping the AppBar/content around it rather than wrapping or growing the banner.
recommendation: Let the banner size to its child's intrinsic height (drop the fixed height, or express it as a minHeight), and add a widget test that pumps OfflineTopBanner under a scaled MediaQuery (TextScaler.linear(1.6)+) and asserts no overflow/clip.
acceptance_criteria: a widget/golden test pumps OfflineTopBanner at textScaler >= 1.6x and asserts the rendered content fits within its layout bounds
the banner Container no longer hard-codes height:32
